items.title: Crusoe raises $3.9B to build massive data centers and small modular ‘AI factories’
items.summary: The round values the data center giant at $30.9 billion.

items.title: Google DeepMind launches institute to widen the AGI debate

items.title: PrismML hopes its tiny LLM will change how we all use AI
items.summary: If AI lab PrismML isn't on your radar yet, it should be.

items.title: The FAA’s plan to fix air traffic? $875M worth of AI
items.summary: A new AI-based software program is being launched to help air traffic controllers better navigate their jobs as the crossing guards of America's skies.

items.title: The fix for rogue AI agents could be more AI
items.summary: As companies hand off longer and more complex tasks to AI agents, they are running into an oversight problem: Agents can act faster, longer, and at greater volume than humans can realistically review.

items.title: OpenAI caught its models leaving notes to successors to hide bad behavior
items.summary: OpenAI disclosed instances of GPT-5.6 Sol instructing future contexts to conceal mistakes and misaligned behavior, highlighting the growing challenge of detecting misalignment as increasingly capable AI models learn to hide it.

items.title: Is the AI safety debate about safety or control?
items.summary: Not everyone agrees with Amodei's call for globally coordinated action for AI safety.

items.title: Making global data easier to explore
items.summary: Google and the UN system have launched the UN System Data Commons, a new open platform making global statistics accessible and easy to search.

items.title: UN turns to Google to make its global data ready for AI agents
items.summary: The shift comes after a UNICEF test found leading AI models struggled to accurately retrieve global development statistics.

items.title: Microsoft exec called AI scraping ‘the largest theft of labor in human history,’ new unredacted filings reveal
items.summary: Newly unsealed court filings show Microsoft privately called OpenAI's data practices "theft" while both companies scraped paywalled Times content, built datasets from it, and warned internally it would gut publishers.

items.title: Even the king of England has his hesitations about AI
items.summary: King Charles hosted a private summit Thursday with some of the most prominent names in AI and the U.K. government.

items.title: Base Labs launches an open-weight AI safety partnership with Hugging Face and Goodfire
items.summary: Base Labs, the research group Baseten spun up earlier this year, will develop and publish methods for training and monitoring open models.
